title: Max Subarray: breaks on all-negative input
problem:
Maximum Subarray Sum.

Input: the first line contains n (1 <= n <= 100000). The second line contains n integers a_1 ... a_n (|a_i| <= 10^9).
Output: a single integer, the maximum sum over all non-empty contiguous subarrays.
code:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
best = 0
cur = 0
for x in a:
    cur = max(0, cur + x)
    best = max(best, cur)
print(best)

title: Longest Increasing Run: non-strict comparison
problem:
Longest Increasing Run.

Input: the first line contains n (1 <= n <= 100000). The second line contains n integers a_1 ... a_n (|a_i| <= 10^9).
Output: a single integer, the length of the longest contiguous subarray in which every element is strictly greater than the previous one.
code:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
best = 1
cur = 1
for i in range(1, n):
    if a[i] >= a[i - 1]:
        cur += 1
    else:
        cur = 1
    best = max(best, cur)
print(best)

title: Lower Bound: wrong upper bound
note: hi = n-1 misses the 'none found' case
problem:
Lower Bound.

Input: the first line contains n (1 <= n <= 100000). The second line contains n integers a_1 <= a_2 <= ... <= a_n (|a_i| <= 10^9), sorted in non-decreasing order. The third line contains an integer x (|x| <= 10^9).
Output: the smallest 0-based index i such that a_i >= x, or n if no such index exists.
code:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
x = int(input())
lo, hi = 0, n - 1
while lo < hi:
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    if a[mid] >= x:
        hi = mid
    else:
        lo = mid + 1
print(lo)

title: Max Subarray: correct solution (expect NO BUG FOUND)
problem:
Maximum Subarray Sum.

Input: the first line contains n (1 <= n <= 100000). The second line contains n integers a_1 ... a_n (|a_i| <= 10^9).
Output: a single integer, the maximum sum over all non-empty contiguous subarrays.
code:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
best = a[0]
cur = a[0]
for x in a[1:]:
    cur = max(x, cur + x)
    best = max(best, cur)
print(best)
